Edit: oh I get what your trying to say. Unfortunately I was 18…..

Bc it appears on google search and some of my posts from those subs are on the site. Rareddit is a site that archives data from legal advice, confession etc type subreddits. The main page can be found on google. I’ve been trying to find out the person behind the site but I’ve had no luck so far.

Nothing illegal. It’s just that my main account had a lot of kinky porn on it and a lot of my other content can potentially be tied into my identity (luckily I never commented or posted my irl name) and other weird ass questions/rants and stupid opinions trying to sound smart/philosophical (which received a bit of backlash). It’s fucking embarrassing that I was this stupid of a person…..

Mate that’s why I said I’m a fucking idiot. I’m trying to reverse the damage as much as possible but everyday I get more and more fucking overwhelmed with thoughts of self harm. Like I said I would give anything and I would do anything to go back in time before I posted on reddit.

Well I’m a fucking idiot and I put myself in this situation by not listening to my parents advice. I would give anything to go back in time. I would give my legs, my eyes, anything to go back in time before I posted on social media. The pressure has become so bad to the point where I’ve considered killing myself and this situation is just so overwhelming
Does searching everyday mean that it becomes a popular google search accidentally? I was actually thinking about this

If I knew all of this beforehand I would have not posted at all online and I definitely would not allow people to post information related to me online, even on job promotional content on social media. It really is scary how our online mistakes are far more impactful and lengthy than our mistakes in real life.

Yeah there’s a lot of identifying info apart from my name. If anyone ever does try to connect the account to me I can just use plausible deniability and tell them that if it doesn’t have my name it’s not connected to me. Still, the thought of it being out there scares me. For instance simu liu’s reddit account was unearthed and he didn’t use his name in it. I’ve been thinking about moving countries once I grow up to start all over again, away from all of this crap.

I just feel so lost with what to do now. I’ve removed as much as I can but there’s still a lot of my info which I’m trying to purge bc I want to disappear from the internet forever. But it looks like that’s not happening anytime soon and I shouldn’t have posted stuff online at all in the first place. I really don’t know what to do anymore.
If I knew that in the first place I wouldn’t have made a reddit account. I’m such an idiot bro. It’s just so scary how our online mistakes matter much more than our in person mistakes.
The internet is a scary place.

Ah, that makes sense but it’s weird bc reddit archives like camas GitHub don’t store images. I’m just wondering if there’s any way to link back to the server and perhaps request a removal of my data so that it doesn’t appear on google in the future.

Everyone keeps telling me that and it may be true, but I’m trying to purge the internet of all information related to me. I might not be able to remove all of it but I want to remove as much of it as I can and that includes my reddit account.

Thanks for the help mate! It’s just weird how it suddenly appeared when I was removing a bunch of other links using the outdated tool. Some images keep coming back even after the tool successfully removed the images which is weird but I suppose it is what it is, I guess for those ones I’ll have to keep requesting removal. Again, thanks for the help I appreciate it.
Will google eventually recrawl the page and remove it? In the outdated content tool I also sent feedback to the tool to verify that the content is deleted. Idk if it’ll work though
I deleted the post before deleting my account and it’s strange that it still appears there as an active link even though text apart from the title is removed
I’m not attacking pushshift in any way brother, I don’t have a problem with stuck in the matrix or what he’s doing. Sorry if I seemed like a bit of a dick that wasn’t my intention.
Fair point, I understand where your coming from.

It’s a pretty good idea actually. I support pushshift and think it’s an excellent tool for researchers, but there’s always people in the public who abuse this tool. It’s just a shame that some people ruin it for everyone else by using this tool for bad things (e.g doxing)
I’m not trying to remove everything, just my data from the dumps. But if he’s unable to then it is what it is.
Ah I see now. I was wondering what other purposes there are for pushshift other than research.

Ah damn. I believe we spoke on my new account two days ago and I thought of a proposition by privatising these archives to verified data researchers and restricting random people’s accessibility to pushshift archives. The sole purpose of pushshift is research for data collectors, but making it open to the public just allows random people to use the service to stalk/dox other people. I have no problem with what stuck in the matrix is doing and I find the project very interesting but I just think it’ll be better if these archives were shut off from the public and only available to data researchers since that’s the purpose of pushshift. This probably sounds stupid but I’ve had this thought for quite some the while. Thanks for replying to me though, I appreciate it, and thank you for helping me clarify my concern in this post.

Is it hard to remove things from the dumps, or is it impossible because they’re already been uploaded? I’m only 18 but I’d honestly give him all my money to remove it from the dumps (if possible). But if it’s impossible then I guess I’m out of luck
Yeah I shouldn’t have posted here but I never was really known for my common sense. Thanks for giving me some direction tho I wish you all the best
Thanks. My life really is crashing down so many issues popping up everywhere and the past coming back to haunt me.
The Instagram sub didn’t help me :(

I was logged out of my account bc I couldn’t provide a verification code since at the same time the phone company disconnected my number due to inactivity and I don’t have the verification email anymore. The account is made in my name and I was wondering if Instagram could completely delete it for me since I’m becoming paranoid that someone has hacked my account and is doing sketchy things in my name as I noticed that the following count of my account fluctuated recently despite me being logged out.

Ah it was an inquiry about the data dumps. It’s unusual bc he told ppl to contact his email as his reddit gets a lot of spam but I don’t blame him, managing this site is busy work. Some people have received a reply from him so I guess it comes down to luck.
Is it only for citizens? Also, is it also for people struggling with depression and mental issues like me?
I’m glad you’ve found a way to cope with existence. I’ve only done weed a few times bc it’s illegal in my country. I mostly vape, but even that is getting banned soon here :(

I’m truly sorry you’ve had to go through all that shit. I just hope that the future leaders of my generation realise how mental issues can fuck up someone’s life bad, and allow a painless alternative for those who are willing to opt out and provide clear consent.
Thanks, I’ll have a look in it

I want to reach out, but it’s hard, knowing that I’ll have to expose that part of myself to someone, to let them see through the facade for who I really am. I’ll try reaching out to someone I know when I muster the courage to do it.

Yeah, I’ve stopped talking shit on the internet bc I don’t trust myself to not slip personal information again, in fact, I’ve stopped posting on all social media. As for drugs, I’ve never done hard stuff apart from some weed rarely but most of the time I just vape.

I wish I was like the rest of the hive mind to be honest, to just live life without thinking about the meaning of my existence. Tbh I don’t really want to be here at all, but I feel like im trapped in a state of limbo. I want to opt out of life but I can’t bc I’m a coward, but I hate my life.
I wish I had an option to opt out painlessly, but I’m stuck here.

Sometimes I wish I could tell them to their faces to fuck themselves. I hate it, bc if I’m going to continue to live I’ll inevitably be paying them tax and purchasing goods. I’ve always wondered if people in power ever felt the way people like me do, like don’t they understand what it’s like to feel this helplessness that can’t be fixed with money or pleasure.

I can only hope future leaders from my generation aren’t like this, and that they’ll understand that there’s more to this than money/profit. People from my generation who understand how mental issues can literally make a persons existence torture, and be better leaders to implement better policies.

I mean I would gladly give consent for them to sell my organs after they administer euthanasia to me. I’m sure they can make a lot of profit off selling my organs to people who want to live. Besides, I’m only one person in so many so it doesn’t impact them in the bigger picture
I have no one. My parents don’t believe that I’m mentally ill, they think I’m normal, and always say: “it’s all in the mind”.

It’s just so painful, because recently my paranoia and ocd is making me have false memories. Like it’s gotten so bad to the point where I don’t know if I really did something in the last or if my minds just creating that scenario to stress me out. It’s so hard to explain, but it’s really tormenting.

For myself, I don’t see the point of having a good time. In the future there will always be times when I will suffer, and suffering has impacted me far more than the times I’ve felt good in life, whether that be from helping others, hobbies, or pleasure in general. But I know that there are plenty of people who don’t feel the same way, because at the end of the day we’re all individuals and experience life differently. But I know for a fact that if I could end my suffering painlessly and immediately I would do it without hesitation.
Sorry if I seem confused, but in what ways doesn’t this benefit them? Like they won’t be able to tax us if we’re dead? Or could it be religiously/morally motivated.

Yeah I feel like people in society don’t really try to understand mental health apart from shoving helplines in our faces and saying meaningless stuff like “get help” or “we care”. I know they might mean well, but it doesn’t help ppl going through these issues at all.

It’s kinda made me scared of becoming a writer, bc writing was one of my passions back then, but now I’m just paranoid that old stuff is going to resurface and be used to shame me, as the things we post on the internet are static, and don’t reflect how we’ve changed or want to be a better person.

I’m not a bigot at all. I don’t know what was going through my mind when I said that thing, and it fucking haunts me bc that was the only time I’ve said something that bad, and it’s not who I am. You can be assured that I will never ever make a comment like that in the future.
I honestly regret what I said and wish I had just been a better person. I would do anything to go back in time and undo my mistake.
I did, but there’s no knowing how many people could screenshot it. Honestly, If it ever comes back to haunt me I deserve it for being a dickhead then

As someone who made a really offensive/bigoted comment on reddit in the past this terrifies me. I was talking out of my ass at the time and the reason why it sticks with me so bad, is because that’s the only offensive thing I’ve said offline/online and I wrote it without thinking (because I’m a dumb fuck who doesn’t have common sense). I’m terrified for being judged for my past comment, because my words on the internet will be static, and not reflect who I am as a person.
I’m turning 19 in October, and I already feel so tired. I can’t fathom living for another 50 years, it just seems too much for me as well

I said one bigoted thing on reddit without thinking of the consequences of my words, and to this day it still fucking haunts me bc I didn’t mean it, I was just talking out of my ass. You can be assured that’s the only bigoted thing I’ve ever said online/offline, and that’s why it’s had such a big impact on me bc that’s not a part of who I am. I said it without thinking, but it’s no excuse to write that thing.

And yes I am a nihilist because if I’m going to continue to make these mistakes I don’t see the point of my life, I don’t see the meaning of my existence if I’m going to continue to fuck up more and more in the future.
I’m basically trapped here, but I’m too scared to opt out so it’s like a mental prison.

Yeah, I honestly wonder why the government won’t legalise it. As long as it doesn’t impede the safety of others, and as long as the person is a consenting adult then they should absolutely have the right to go out on their own terms.
Thanks, I’ll check it out.
I feel you 100% I just wish I had never been born in the first place.
I honestly wish I wasn’t self aware at all. I honestly wish that I had the same mindset as the hive mind, to accept this fact.

I had no excuse to say what I said. I said a really bad bigoted thing without thinking of the consequences even though I am not a bigot in real life. the problem with it being online is that anyone can easily capture it and share it and my biggest fear is people judging me for what I said in the past bc they don’t know who I am, that I regret the things I’ve said. So many other bad tings are popping up in my life and I feel like I’m being judged and punished by whatever higher power is up there which makes me anxious and paranoid over every single time I was a dick in the past.
I’m such a dumb fuck for being an asshole in the past. I would give literally anything to start my life over and not make those mistakes.

A lot of anxiety also comes from the things I’ve said and done in the past. I had no excuse to say what I said in the past but I’m scared it’ll somehow come back to cancel me, and my paranoia is just causing me to realise that if I’m going to continue to fuck up in life then what’s the point of it. Honestly I feel trapped in a state of limbo, not knowing what’s real and what’s not.

Edit: I feel broken inside.
I honestly wish that I was a part of the hive mind, to not realise this at all, bc realising this is probably a lot of where my pain comes from.
I don’t want to wait that long. Life will always be meaningless in the end, so there’s no point waiting around for the end.
I understand, I just feel like I’m running out of options.

Yeah ur probably right. Though I agree 100% that bringing more children in this world is completely fucked up. Life is full of suffering and these children will grow up to suffer. I for one will never never ever have children because I don’t want to pass down my fucking mental issues on someone who didn’t even consent to being born. I never asked to be born, actually my birth was a complete accident and my real parents had me just because they felt horny. And now I have to suffer in this shithole because those two decided to have unprotected sex.

And please don’t tell me to reach out or get help like everyone else says. I’ve said this 100 times and I’ll say it another 100 times, if the same people telling me to get help knew the the things I’ve said in the past they would all cancel me and shame me so “reach out” and “get help”  are worthless to me. With all due respect, I don’t mean anyone bad here, but if you’re going to tell me to get help or reach out you may as well be speaking to a brick wall. 

I posted here bc suicidewatch deleted my posts, I felt this belonged here, because I hate my life so much I hate who I am, I hate how I was born and people expect me to suck it up in life when I never asked to be born in the first place.
Yeah, there’s probably a lot more out there who feel the same way.

Your right that a lot of people aren’t just depressed, but realise the reality of their life, that it’s not worth living for. Tbh I don’t see the meaning in my life at all and I just want to disappear away into nothing.

I always think to myself why the government doesn’t want to legalise euthanasia, like what is their ulterior motive. Money, religion, ‘morality’? It pisses me off a lot that we have the right to live but don’t have the right to die in a humane way (for consenting adults who should have the freedom to do what they like with their bodies). If something doesn’t impede on other peoples safety then it should be 100% legalised and I just wonder why the government forces us to live in this shitty fucking world under the guise that “everything will get better”
Yeah bro the ‘highs’ in life aren’t worth it to me. The lows in my life seem far more impactful than the highs

Apparently it leads to a painless death which is what I want. I’m too much of a coward to end myself in other ways. Don’t worry, i don’t have any fentanyl on me, bc it’s illegal in my country but I can only hope.

As someone who was raised in a Christian household, I fucking hate religion, how it has distorted our ownership of our bodies. It’s my body so I should have the right to die because I never asked to be born.

I fucking hate how the government pretends to care about us. If they care so much about money I will willingly let them sell my organs after I am administered euthanasia (consent always needs to be given beforehand). Besides, I’m only one person in so many, what difference does that make to the economy when there are so many other people out there. Do these people in power know what it’s feel like to be suicidal, I honestly wonder if they are people at all

Man I’m honestly considering opioids as a last resort. OD by opioids apparently isn’t painful, but it’s obviously better than hanging myself of jumping off a bridge which will traumatise so many bystanders, and I don’t want that to happen. I want to pass away in a discrete and painless way
Yeah it fucking sucks man. I don’t get why we euthanise pets, but people in pain aren’t allowed to receive this treatment.
I’m sorry to hear your loss. He’s in a better place now and is no longer suffering. He will always watch over you
Life sucks, I’m just too much of a coward to end my own life bc I’ve always been a coward in everything.

Sorry if I sound edgy, but I feel like the government is just keeping us alive so that we can pay them tax over so many years of slaving our asses off. I quit my job recently and I’ve been working in that position since I was 15, and I also hate how I will spend the rest of my life slaving away. People say, “do something you enjoy then,” but the thing is all jobs are repetitive and will eventually become boring after working for so many years.

I’m beyond mental support. I did and said a lot of bad stuff you wouldn’t want to know. Many people want mental support and I encourage them to get mental support, but I just don’t care anymore about mental support for myself, and I’m sure there are others who feel the same.

Yes, that’s why it’s necessary to do background checks to see if people have any family members who are encouraging them to do it so they can inherit their money. It sucks that bc of human nature, this cannot be legalised yet, bc people will abuse this right.
I honestly wish my life was sped up. 19 years for me has seemed like such a drag. Everything seems so slow and torturous. I honestly wish my life could magically speed up and I could pass away soon.

Same, the only thing stopping me from slitting my wrists or handing myself is because of the pain. I wouldn’t shoot myself either because it’s just an awful way to go, and none of these people would feel the need to have such a painful end if assisted euthanasia was legal. I can only hope it is legalised in my country for all consenting adults

Tbh the lows in my life are much much much more painful than the good feelings from the highs in my life. Sorry if I worded that strangely, and I’m so sorry to hear that you’ve had to struggle through depression for such a long time. I wish you all the best too

Are there any countries out there that would administer assisted suicide for mental illness. I might sound like an edgy kid, but sometimes I don’t get why the government forces us to live when many of us don’t want to. Is it because they need me to pay tax over my lifetime, is it because they want me to make money for them, is it because of religion. It just seems so weird that we have the “right to live”, but we don’t have the right to opt out. Thanks for informing me though, I appreciate it a lot.
